title: MULTI-BLADE KNIFE ASSEMBLY WITH PROTECTIVE COVER
notes: MISIDENTIFIED IN DISCOVERY — NOT AN ICOTROKINRA PATENT. The real WO2023212432A1 is 'Multi-Blade Knife Assembly with Protective Cover' by Larry Kalkstein (PCT/US2023/062923; priority US provisional 63/363,577 filed 2022-04-26; IPC B26B), unrelated to IL-23/icotrokinra. Discovery mislabeled this number as an icotrokinra oral-formulation PCT. FLAG FOR HUMAN REVIEW: do not use WO2023212432 for icotrokinra; correct WO number not source-confirmed.
